archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) - Dark Mode Developer Tool Variant

typography.heading_font: Cabinet Grotesk, Space Mono, or JetBrains Mono
typography.body_font: JetBrains Mono or IBM Plex Mono
typography.general_rules: No Inter. Use radical weight contrast. Monospace fonts MUST be used for all data, logs, and metrics visualization for tabular alignment.

colors.rules: Color is Function Only. 95% of the UI should be monochrome. Color exists only to guide action or indicate status (hit = success, miss = danger). Never use pure #000000; #0A0A0A acts as base.

grid_rules: Base Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4, gap-4 or gap-6
Widgets must utilize h-full. No jagged bottoms.
Main Chart (Ring or Load): col-span-2 row-span-2 or col-span-3
layout_and_spacing.container_padding: Containers with borders must have internal padding (p-4 or p-6) to prevent text collision.

surfaces_and_components.cards_widgets: GRID BORDERS (The 'Technical' Look). Container uses flat dark background (#141414) with 1px solid border-border/40, sharp edges or max 4px border-radius. No soft shadows.
surfaces_and_components.buttons: Square or very subtle rounded (max rounded-md). High contrast background (Primary accent or pure white) for main actions. For secondary actions, flat background with 1px subtle border.
surfaces_and_components.inputs: Shadcn UI Input customized with sharp edges, dark background (#0A0A0A), and 1px border. Focus state must use ring-2 ring-primary.
visual_effects: No heavy gradients. Use 1px sharp inner borders or solid backgrounds.
The 'Tracing Beam' effect on the Consistent Hashing Ring or Active Node to signify active processing.
Terminal Look: Subtle glowing drop-shadow on active/hit states.
component_libraries: Custom SVG for the Consistent Hashing Ring visualization (for complex data mapping)

animations_and_motion.micro_interactions: Hover states must have HIGHER contrast (e.g., bg-white/10 text-white).
animations_and_motion.data_flow: Real-time updates should flash the respective node or log entry briefly (e.g., success color for Hit, danger color for Miss).
animations_and_motion.hashing_ring: Use smooth SVG stroke animations or framer-motion to visualize a key travelling to its respective node.

images.description: Black and white photo of a network of dots. Use at 10% opacity as a texture in empty states or hero headers.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio for text. Text shadow if needed.
accessibility_and_testing.test_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='add-node-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the dashboard using a strict 'Control Room' dense grid.
Use a monochrome palette (#0A0A0A to #FFFFFF) where colors (Green/Red) are STRICTLY reserved for cache Miss/Hit or critical statuses.
For the Consistent Hashing Ring, render an SVG where nodes are plotted on a circle. Animate data points (keys) moving to their corresponding node.
Ensure all metrics update in real-time or simulate real-time updates.
Use JetBrains Mono or similar monospace font for all numbers, logs, and keys to give it a developer terminal aesthetic.
